services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: Six to ten minutes at 400 feet where the boat noise disappears and the bay does the talking. This is the flight we've flown since 2007, off the same pier, under the same yellow flags. An hour on the water, a slow winch up to 400 feet, and the moment every flyer remembers: the wind steadies, the engine fades, and Biscayne Bay unrolls underneath you - turquoise flats, the Grove's green shoreline, downtown stacked on the horizon. Up to three fly together on one canopy. Feet stay dry on the boat deck at both ends, unless you request the dip. Ages 5 and up, no swimming needed, 450 lbs combined per flight. The operational details our captains brief at the dock - covered here so you can plan. Fuel
